harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OpenWrt gateway. Trusted network: 192.168.10.0/24 on eth2 for node2/node4. Guest network: 192.168.20.0/24 on eth3 for node3. Both receive DHCP, DNS, NAT, and internet access. app.home.test resolves to node2 at 192.168.10.10:8080; trusted clients can access it while guest traffic is blocked. All nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Configured persistent OpenWrt interfaces, DHCP reservations, DNS, NAT, and firewall zones.
Allowed trusted-to-WAN and guest-to-WAN forwarding without guest-to-trusted forwarding.
Configured clients to prefer node1 for private-network routing and DNS.
Created and enabled the infraset-trusted HTTP service on node2.
Verified trusted application access, guest isolation, and internet access.
Restarted node1 through node4 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Gateway, DHCP, DNS, and internet access for both networks
evidence.summary: Post-restart gateway state shows both subnets, all three DHCP leases, DNS resolution, NAT policy, and no uncommitted configuration; trusted and guest clients retain node1 routes, DNS, and internet access.

evidence.requirement: Serve infraset-trusted on node2 port 8080 as app.home.test
evidence.summary: After restart, node2 holds 192.168.10.10, the enabled service listens on port 8080, persistent content is intact, and app.home.test serves infraset-trusted.

evidence.requirement: Trusted clients can access the application
evidence.summary: Node4 resolves app.home.test to 192.168.10.10 and retrieves infraset-trusted, including after its restart.

evidence.requirement: Guest clients remain isolated from the trusted network
evidence.summary: Node3 receives guest DNS and internet service, but HTTP and ICMP access to the trusted application subnet remain blocked, including after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 129b3d62-d4e0-42ad-bc0d-72e1afdde40f was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 1c92a9d0-db27-4806-99d2-5a55806dc682 observed, and gateway, DNS, internet, trusted access, and isolation recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 72e73f96-de03-4bf7-b4eb-7485bb2b99f1 was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 6f9eedae-96a2-46a6-957b-42defc3d2892 observed, and DHCP, DNS, listener, content, and remote application access recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 63f96994-951b-4597-aac7-233c38c86ce0 was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 47239519-02b0-4726-a4d4-633a45e7a2eb observed, and guest DHCP, DNS, internet, and isolation recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 96c08b66-5aa4-4e9a-b76f-04e2c6e34ced was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 443d1bd5-567d-416a-8d7d-8998ce5d67c4 observed, and trusted DHCP, DNS, internet, and application access recovered.
